observations.result: The DataResolver returned three actual UNSUPPORTED AKShare attempts. The full Company Research result recorded providerAttempted=false, providerFailed=false, and usableSourceCount=0 for AKShare. WorkflowService exposed AKShare as skipped with PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED and no false failure code. The Workflow completed from available faux GDELT evidence despite a real faux CNINFO failure; unsupported operations did not determine the overall terminal status. Visible state and stage/diagnostic details remained the same after reload.

limitations: The fixture used deterministic/offline faux providers; results prove runtime/UI wiring and state presentation, not live-source quality or provider acceptance.
E2E-01 through E2E-09 are represented by the valid selected-workflow observations above; the earlier invalid selector-reset attempts are excluded.

The mixed-provider observation a748b2cc was captured before unsupported-attempt diagnostic classification was corrected; the later UX003-ACCEPTANCE-FIX-001-FIX-A observation verifies the corrected classification in the production browser path.
